title: Every admin app page load uses the shared free daily request limit, and at the limit the admin app may not open at all
what: Our web server is set to run its own code first for every address except the hashed picture and script files. So each opening or refresh of the admin app, its icons, its offline helper file and every gym invite, check-in and join page counts against the free plan's 100,000 requests a day for all of MettleUp. Plain files served without our code would not count. When the limit is passed, Cloudflare shows its own error page: the apps' fallback to the gym server's direct address only helps an app that is already open, so a desk that opens the admin app fresh (with no saved copy in the browser), and every person opening a gym link, sees an error until 05:30 India time.
expected: Only the addresses that need our code (the gym server pass-through, the /api calls and the gym link pages) run it; the admin app's own files are served as plain files that do not use up the daily limit, and what a desk sees at the limit is written down.
who: every gym desk and anyone opening a gym link
how_often: every day the shared limit is passed; every page load adds to the count
fix_line: Run our code only for the addresses that need it and let the admin app's plain files be served without it

title: The gym web page chat's AI cost is written only to a passing log line
what: Each AI answer in the chat on a gym's web page works out its cost but only prints it in a log line, which Cloudflare keeps for a few days. It is not added to any usage count, so HQ cannot see what the page chat costs per gym or per month, and it has no money ceiling of its own; only the gym's AI credits and the 30-a-day limit hold it back. It uses the same paid AI key as the owner's AI Assistant. Not live today: the chat is switched off.
expected: Page chat calls and tokens are counted like the help answers and the AI Assistant, shown on HQ's AI cost, and covered by a monthly ceiling with a warning before it.
how_often: every page chat answer once the chat is switched on
fix_line: Count page chat tokens in the small web database and add them to HQ's AI cost and a monthly ceiling
